subject: E-Commerce
title: Dynamic Pricing: Prices That Watch You
description: A quick win: understand Dynamic Pricing: Prices That Watch You.

hook.text: Amazon changes product prices 2.5 million times per day. The price you see depends on when and how you shop.

buildup.text: Algorithms adjust prices based on demand, competitor pricing, time of day, and even your browsing history.

discovery.text: Uber's surge pricing is dynamic pricing in real-time. Prices double at peak demand to balance supply.

twist.text: Airlines were caught charging more to users on expensive devices. Your gadget reveals your willingness to pay.

climax.text: Dynamic pricing means two shoppers see different prices for the same item. Personalized pricing is here.

punchline.text: 2.5 million price changes daily. The price tag is watching you back.

quiz.question: How often does Amazon change its product prices?
